claims.text: Chemical pleurodesis via the thoracostomy tube w tetracyclines (doxycycline, minocycline) or talc.
claims.quote: chemical pleurodesis can be performed with the introduction of irritants such as tetracyclines (ie, doxycycline, minocycline) or talc via the thoracostomy tube.

claims.text: Used if thoracoscopy can't be done or is CI;
claims.quote: If thoracoscopy cannot be performed or is contraindicated, chemical pleurodesis through a chest tube may be performed
VATS is the preferred technique where possible
